metaDescription: Advance your practice with our 300hr Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu, Bali. Yoga Alliance certified 25-day immersion in advanced asana, pranayama & philosophy.
summary: This advanced course builds on your 200 hour training, diving deeper into poses, breathing, meditation, mantras, and yoga philosophy.
intro: Join Bali Yoga School's 300 hour yoga teacher training in Uluwatu and master traditional styles like Hatha, Ashtanga, and Vinyasa.

This advanced course builds on your 200 hour training, diving deeper into poses, breathing, meditation, mantras, and yoga philosophy. Learn to teach with confidence, design classes, and understand body alignment.
Our easy-to-follow classes mix theory and practice, with time to relax and reflect. You'll graduate as a skilled, certified yoga teacher, ready to inspire others.

curriculum.title: Ashtanga Vinyasa Flow
items: 1st week – Recap of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Half Primary Series / Memorizing and understanding the sequence to prepare for Mysore practice.

2nd & 3rd week – Mysore-style practice of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series to help each of you develop at your own pace / Led Class of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series / Teaching practice

curriculum.title: Dhyan (Meditation)
items: Om Mani Padme Hum Buddha Mantra Meditation
Manipura Chakra (Solar Plexus Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Ajna Chakra (Third Eye Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Yoga Nidra Meditation with Sound Healing Bowls

curriculum.title: Yoga Therapy
items: Yoga Therapy for Nervous System Issues

curriculum.title: Ayurveda
items: Dosha, Dhatus, Mala, Agni, and Ama

curriculum.title: Pranayama (Breathing Practices)
items: Nadi Shodhana Pranayama / Anulom Vilom Pranayama
Surya Bhedana Pranayama / Chandra Bhedi Pranayama

curriculum.title: Yoga Philosophy
items: Shad Darshan (Classification of Indian Philosophy, Aastika & Naastika Darshan)
Introduction of Patanjali Yoga Sutras / 4 Chapter of PYS

curriculum.title: Yoga Anatomy & Physiology
items: Brief Introduction of Skeleton System & Function
Anatomy of Shoulder & Function with Important Name of Muscles
Anatomy of Pelvic Girdle with Names of Muscles
Spine Anatomy & Function / Importance in Yoga Practice
Chakra Introduction & Function with the Endocrine System
Nadis – the Energy Channel Function & Importance
Prana Introduction & Importance in Organ Function
Panchakosha Importance in Function of the Body

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 10:00 am with the opening ceremony & orientation program. In order to attend the opening ceremony of the course you should arrive at school a day before the starting date of the course. The course completes on 27th of every month at 7:00 pm with graduation & fire ceremony performed by the graduates & their masters. Departure date is 28th of every month before 12:00 pm.

The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: This advanced course builds on your 200 hour training.

All students joining our 300-hour Yoga Teacher Training are required to complete the prerequisite assignment before arrival and submit it during check-in. Please print the assignment and compile it into a file for submission. This process ensures that all participants begin the training with a strong foundation for a meaningful and enriching learning experience.

Upon confirmation of your 300-hour YTT booking, we will provide the assignment questions along with our 200-hour YTT course manual. If you are unable to complete the assignment due to limited time before the course starts, you may submit it within the first 7 days of the training.
Students are also recommended to start incorporating yoga practices in their day-to-day life before the course.
